## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：这次只做出 Studio 全屏详情共用的头部零件，还没有放进任何页面。
- 属于「Studio 重构」大卡，替后面四张接入卡（对象、流程、通用详情等全屏详情页）先定下头部和「上一个/下一个」的接口。
- 出错也碰不到用户，因为没有页面用它；可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- New `StudioDetailHeader` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-detail/StudioDetailHeader.tsx`): a thin composite over `StudioItemHeader`'s slots. × (back to the list) in `leading`; the type and the source package as identity chips after the label and api name; the status as the header's status chip; in `actions`, ‹ › with "index / total", the page's primary button (a slot), and ⋯ (the page's own menu items, with the folded chips above them via `StudioItemHeaderFoldedItems`). No switcher dropdown, no "open in app" (epic decision 7).
- The ‹ › data interface is a plain prop: `sequence={{ names, current }}` plus `onOpenItem(name)`. `detailSequence(names, current)` (exported, pure) computes the 1-based index, total, previous and next; the ends do not wrap; a name the list does not hold has no position and both steps are off. The order itself comes later from the list card (decision 10: filter and sort in the detail address, by name without list context).
- × , Esc and ‹ › all go through the existing leave-guard seam `confirmUnsavedLeave` in `chrome/unsavedEdits.ts`; browser Back is not intercepted (decision 12). Esc is ignored when a menu or dialog already handled it (Radix marks it `defaultPrevented`), when it is aimed at a text field, or with a modifier; `closeOnEscape={false}` turns it off.
- Narrow widths reuse `StudioItemHeader`'s rules unchanged: the identity chips (api name, type, package) fold into ⋯ first; the position text carries `data-studio-fold-label` / `STUDIO_FOLD_LABEL` so it leaves the row at the second stage while ‹ › stay; the title is cut last. The composite does no measuring of its own.
- Strings: `engine.studio.detailHeader.*` (close, previous, next, position, notInList, package, more) in the `studio` namespace, en + zh.
- Not wired into any page (later cards do that). `StudioItemHeader.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `unsavedEdits.ts` are read, not edited. Placement: a new sibling folder `views/studio-detail/` rather than `studio-design/`, so this PR adds nothing under the `studio-design/**` surface another open card holds.

## Tests

- `StudioDetailHeader.test.tsx` (24 tests): index math (middle, first, last, lone, outside the list, empty list); first/last disabled; ‹ › open the neighbours; the leave guard on × and › (Cancel keeps the page, OK leaves, nothing unsaved means no prompt); Esc triggers × (through the guard), not from a text field, not while ⋯ is open (that Esc closes the menu, the next one closes the page), not with `closeOnEscape` off or a modifier; ×, ‹, › are native buttons in tab order; the narrow-row fold at stubbed widths (wide 900 px nothing folds; 560 px chips fold into ⋯; 380 px the position label folds too; it follows resizes both ways; without menu items the header draws its own ⋯ only while folded).
- Test page `ui/e2e/studio-detail-header-width.spec.ts`: the real component and real Tailwind in Chromium at a 1024 px row (everything whole, nothing folded, every box inside the row) and a 360 px row (chips folded into ⋯, position text out, both fold stages taken, ×, ‹, ›, ⋯ inside the row, no overflow), plus keyboard: Tab from ‹ reaches ›, Enter steps, Esc triggers ×.

## Acceptance notes

- The test page is a Playwright spec (the repo has no Storybook); it measures geometry, so it follows `e2e/studio-item-header-title-width.spec.ts`'s bundling.
- Esc is not advertised in the keyboard-shortcuts dialog: the composite is mounted nowhere yet, and advertising belongs beside the handler once a page mounts it (the wiring cards).
- The changeset declares `Clause-②: no` as the claim says; a sibling i18n-only changeset declared `yes (widening)` for added keys, so the seat may want to confirm which reading applies to new keys in the `studio` namespace.
- At a 360 px row the title is cut (about 44 px in this container's fallback font) after both fold stages: that is `StudioItemHeader`'s existing last step, not new behaviour.

## Verification

Files to read first: `StudioDetailHeader.tsx` (the Esc listener and the ⋯ / `foldMenu` choice are the risk hunks), then `StudioDetailHeader.test.tsx`'s narrow-width block.
